title: Phase 0.6: 'Open Mindless' goes to /mindless, the get-paid and billing help answers are findable questions, and the Space CRM article is Community Resonance
detail: Three small launch fixes from the plan's §8 help center audit and §14 row 0.6. (1) The 'Open Mindless' doors in the Calm down fast and The Quest templates (lib/page-editor/templates/calm-down-fast.ts, the-quest.ts) pointed at /on-air; both now land on /mindless, the public five-minute timer a signed-out reader can run (LIVE-805). Both slugs are editable pages (lib/page-editor/data.ts), so a stored `pages` row saved before this change keeps its own link until it is re-seeded or edited; this row fixes the template, not stored rows. (2) content/help/spaces/get-paid.md and billing.md wrote their Common questions as bold paragraphs, so extractFaq (lib/help/content-core.ts) emitted no FAQPage on the two money pages; each question is now a `### Question?` heading (7 on get-paid, 4 on billing). (3) content/help/spaces/space-crm.md, titled 'Your Space Contacts', is now content/help/spaces/community-resonance.md titled Community Resonance (docs/NAMING.md, CRM / messaging surfaces); next.config.ts 308s /help/spaces/space-crm to the new slug on the Dispatches pattern, and the two inbound links (spaces/teaching-across-studios.md, connecting/import-contacts.md) follow.
